questions.stem: Supplementary (Zhao, Ch. 6). Apply the Robbins–Monro iteration $w_{k+1} = w_k - a_k\tilde g(w_k)$ to $g(w) = w - 10$ with no noise, $w_1 = 20$ and $a_k = 0.5$. Find $w_2$, $w_3$ and $w_4$.
questions.explanation: Each step halves the distance to the root $w^* = 10$.

questions.stem: Supplementary (Zhao, Ch. 6). In Zhao's Robbins–Monro theorem (Theorem 6.1), which condition is placed on the observation error $\eta_k$?
optionNotes: Correct: this is condition (c) of Theorem 6.1.
Zhao notes explicitly that the condition does not require the error to be Gaussian.
Zero error is only the simple illustrative example before the theorem. The theorem is about noisy observations.
$c_2$ bounds the gradient of $g$ in condition (a). It is not a bound on the noise.
solution: Theorem 6.1 has three conditions: (a) bounds on the gradient of $g$, (b) the step sizes satisfy $\sum a_k = \infty$ and $\sum a_k^2 < \infty$, and (c) the error has zero conditional mean and finite conditional variance.
An i.i.d. error with zero mean and finite variance satisfies (c).
questions.explanation: Condition (b) has the same form as the step-size conditions (2.7) of the core text, §2.4.

verification.note: Theorem 6.1 and its discussion, Zhao printed pp. 106–107.
